The JWT token is automatically set and valid for 30 days. security: [] requestBody: required: true content: application/json: schema: type: object required: - email - password properties: email: type: string format: email password: type: string minLength: 8 example: email: user@example.com password: SecurePassword123! responses: '201': description: User created successfully, JWT token set in cookie headers: Set-Cookie: description: JWT authentication token (HTTP-only, 30 days) schema: type: string example: talehaven_auth_token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9...; Path=/; HttpOnly; Max-Age=2592000 content: application/json: example: message: Account created successfully user: id: 1 email: user@example.com created_at: '2026-05-10T12:00:00Z' '400': description: Invalid request data content: application/json: example: error: Invalid request message: "Key: 'RegisterRequest.Password' Error:Field validation for 'Password' failed on the 'min' tag" '409': description: Email already exists content: application/json: example: error: Email already exists message: An account with this email already exists /auth/login: post: summary: Login with email and password description: | Authenticates user and returns a JWT token in an HTTP-only cookie. The JWT token is automatically set and valid for 30 days. security: [] requestBody: required: true content: application/json: schema: type: object required: - email - password properties: email: type: string format: email password: type: string example: email: user@example.com password: SecurePassword123! responses: '200': description: Login successful, JWT token set in cookie headers: Set-Cookie: description: JWT authentication token (HTTP-only, 30 days) schema: type: string example: talehaven_auth_token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9...; Path=/; HttpOnly; Max-Age=2592000 content: application/json: example: message: Login successful user: id: 1 email: user@example.com created_at: '2026-05-10T12:00:00Z' '400': description: Invalid request data content: application/json: example: error: Invalid request message: "Key: 'LoginRequest.Email' Error:Field validation for 'Email' failed on the 'email' tag" '401': description: Invalid credentials content: application/json: example: error: Invalid credentials message: Invalid email or password /auth/logout: post: summary: Logout current user description: Clears the JWT authentication cookie security: [] responses: '200': description: Logout successful, JWT cookie cleared headers: Set-Cookie: description: JWT cookie cleared schema: type: string example: talehaven_auth_token=; Path=/; HttpOnly; Max-Age=-1 content: application/json: example: message: Logged out successfully /auth/me: get: summary: Get current authenticated user information description: Requires valid JWT token in cookie. User info is decoded from the JWT token. responses: '200': description: User information retrieved content: application/json: example: user: id: 1 email: user@example.com created_at: '2026-05-10T12:00:00Z' '401': description: Not authenticated or token expired/invalid content: application/json: examples: noToken: summary: No JWT token found value: error: Authentication required message: You must be logged in to access this resource expiredToken: summary: Token expired value: error: Token expired message: Your session has expired. Please log in again invalidToken: summary: Invalid token value: error: Invalid token message: Your session is invalid. Please log in again /auth/password: put: summary: Change password for authenticated user description: Requires valid JWT token. User is identified from the JWT token. requestBody: required: true content: application/json: schema: type: object required: - old_password - new_password properties: old_password: type: string new_password: type: string minLength: 8 example: old_password: OldPassword123! new_password: NewSecurePassword456! responses: '200': description: Password changed successfully content: application/json: example: message: Password changed successfully '400': description: Invalid request data content: application/json: example: error: Invalid request message: "Key: 'ChangePasswordRequest.NewPassword' Error:Field validation for 'NewPassword' failed on the 'min' tag" '401': description: Not authenticated or incorrect old password content: application/json: example: error: Invalid password message: Current password is incorrect /auth/account: delete: summary: Delete current user account description: Requires valid JWT token. Permanently deletes the authenticated user's account. responses: '200': description: Account deleted successfully content: application/json: example: message: Account deleted successfully '401': description: Not authenticated content: application/json: example: error: Authentication required message: You must be logged in to delete your account # ========================================== # Google Books API (Disabled) # ========================================== /search/books: get: summary: Search Google Books security: [] parameters: - name: bookId in: path required: true schema: type: string responses: '200': description: Book payload content: application/json: example: booksList: {} /manga/search: get: summary: Search manga description: | Search for manga by title with optional tag filtering. **Cover URLs:** - Automatically included for all results (512px quality) - Format: `https://uploads.mangadex.org/covers/{mangaId}/{fileName}.512.jpg` - Direct MangaDex CDN links security: [] parameters: - name: title in: query required: true schema: type: string example: naruto - name: limit in: query required: false schema: type: integer example: 10 - name: offset in: query required: false schema: type: integer example: 0 - name: includedTags[] in: query required: false schema: type: array items: type: string style: form explode: true - name: excludedTags[] in: query required: false schema: type: array items: type: string style: form explode: true responses: '200': description: Search results content: application/json: example: result: ok data: [] total: 0 limit: 10 offset: 0 /manga/popular: get: summary: Get popular manga description: | Returns popular manga ordered by follower count (most followed) or rating. Each manga includes full cover image URLs ready for display. **Features:** - Automatic cover URL generation (512px quality) - Cache enabled (15 minute TTL) - Filter by tags - Order by followedCount (default) or rating **Cover URLs:** - Format: `https://uploads.mangadex.org/covers/{mangaId}/{fileName}.512.jpg` - Example: `abc123.jpg` becomes `abc123.jpg.512.jpg` (512px quality) - Direct MangaDex CDN links - no proxy needed - Ready to use in `` tags **Use case:** Display trending/popular manga on homepage or discovery page. security: [] parameters: - name: limit in: query required: false schema: type: integer default: 20 minimum: 1 maximum: 100 description: Number of results to return example: 20 - name: offset in: query required: false schema: type: integer default: 0 minimum: 0 description: Offset for pagination example: 0 - name: orderBy in: query required: false schema: type: string enum: [followedCount, rating] default: followedCount description: Sort order - followedCount (most popular) or rating (highest rated) example: followedCount - name: includedTags[] in: query required: false schema: type: array items: type: string format: uuid style: form explode: true description: Filter by tags (UUID array) - name: excludedTags[] in: query required: false schema: type: array items: type: string format: uuid style: form explode: true description: Exclude tags (UUID array) responses: '200': description: Popular manga list with cover URLs content: application/json: schema: type: object properties: result: type: string example: ok data: type: array items: type: object properties: id: type: string format: uuid title: type: string description: type: string coverUrl: type: string format: uri description: Full MangaDex cover URL (512px quality) authors: type: array items: type: string artists: type: array items: type: string status: type: string year: type: integer tags: type: array items: type: string total: type: integer description: Total results available limit: type: integer offset: type: integer example: result: ok data: - name: mangaId in: path required: true schema: type: string - name: quality in: query required: false schema: type: string enum: [256, 512] example: '512' responses: '200': description: Cover download started/completed content: application/json: example: result: ok message: Cover downloaded successfully mangaId: a77742b1-befd-49a4-bff5-1ad4e6b0ef7b /chapter/{chapterId}: get: summary: Get chapter by ID security: [] parameters: - name: chapterId in: path required: true schema: type: string responses: '200': description: Chapter details content: application/json: example: result: ok data: {} /chapter/{chapterId}/pages: get: summary: Get/download local chapter pages (also triggers next-chapter prefetch) security: [] parameters: - name: chapterId in: path required: true schema: type: string - name: quality in: query required: false schema: type: string enum: [data, saver] example: data responses: '200': description: Local page paths content: application/json: example: result: ok mangaId: a77742b1-befd-49a4-bff5-1ad4e6b0ef7b chapterId: 73af4d8d-1532-4a72-b1b9-8f4e5cd295c9 pages: - /images/manga/{mangaId}/chapters/{chapterId}/1.jpg - /images/manga/{mangaId}/chapters/{chapterId}/2.jpg pageCount: 2 /chapter/{chapterId}/pages/stream: get: summary: Stream pages progressively as they finish downloading (SSE) security: [] parameters: - name: chapterId in: path required: true schema: type: string - name: quality in: query required: false schema: type: string enum: [data, saver] example: data responses: '200': description: text/event-stream events (`start`, many `page`, optional `page_error`, `complete`) content: text/event-stream: example: | event:start data:{"result":"ok","chapterId":"...","message":"Starting progressive download"} event:page data:{"chapterId":"...","mangaId":"...","pageNumber":1,"totalPages":53,"pageUrl":"/images/manga/.../1.jpg","downloaded":true} event:complete data:{"result":"ok","chapterId":"...","mangaId":"...","totalPages":53,"successCount":53} /chapter/{chapterId}/download: post: summary: Start async chapter download security: [] parameters: - name: chapterId in: path required: true schema: type: string - name: quality in: query required: false schema: type: string enum: [data, saver] example: data responses: '202': description: Download job accepted content: application/json: example: result: ok message: Chapter download started chapterId: 73af4d8d-1532-4a72-b1b9-8f4e5cd295c9 /reading-progress: post: summary: Save or update chapter progress (Redis only - fast!) description: | Requires authentication (JWT token). Writes progress to Redis cache only for instant response (~1-2ms). **Architecture:** - Writes to Redis with 30-minute TTL - Does NOT write to PostgreSQL (use /sync endpoint for that) - Suitable for rapid page turns **When to use:** - Every time user changes page (5 → 6 → 7...) - High frequency updates **When to sync to DB:** - Call `/reading-progress/sync` when user leaves chapter - Or on tab close, chapter switch, etc. requestBody: required: true content: application/json: schema: type: object required: - mangaId - chapterId - currentPage properties: mangaId: type: string format: uuid chapterId: type: string format: uuid currentPage: type: integer minimum: 1 description: Current page number (renamed from lastPage) totalPages: type: integer description: Total pages in chapter (optional) example: mangaId: a77742b1-befd-49a4-bff5-1ad4e6b0ef7b chapterId: 73af4d8d-1532-4a72-b1b9-8f4e5cd295c9 currentPage: 15 totalPages: 53 responses: '200': description: Progress saved to Redis content: application/json: example: result: ok message: Reading progress updated successfully '401': description: Not authenticated content: application/json: example: error: Unauthorized message: authentication required - please login get: summary: Get all progress for current user description: | Requires authentication. Returns all reading progress for the authenticated user. **Data source:** PostgreSQL (persistent storage) **Note:** This returns permanent progress data, not Redis cache. responses: '200': description: All progress from PostgreSQL content: application/json: example: result: ok data: userId: 123 mangas: "a77742b1-befd-49a4-bff5-1ad4e6b0ef7b": mangaId: a77742b1-befd-49a4-bff5-1ad4e6b0ef7b chapters: "73af4d8d-1532-4a72-b1b9-8f4e5cd295c9": currentPage: 15 totalPages: 53 lastReadAt: '2026-05-10T15:30:00Z' updatedAt: '2026-05-10T15:30:00Z' updatedAt: '2026-05-10T15:30:00Z' '401': description: Not authenticated content: application/json: example: error: Unauthorized message: no session identifier found - please login delete: summary: Delete all progress for current user description: | Requires authentication. Deletes ALL reading progress for the authenticated user. **Deletion scope:** - Removes ALL chapters from Redis cache - Removes ALL chapters from PostgreSQL database - Progress cannot be recovered **Warning:** This action is irreversible! responses: '200': description: All progress deleted from both Redis and PostgreSQL content: application/json: example: result: ok message: All reading progress deleted successfully /reading-progress/sync: post: summary: Sync reading progress to PostgreSQL (NEW!) description: | **IMPORTANT:** Syncs Redis cache data to PostgreSQL for permanent storage. **Architecture:** 1. Reads current progress from Redis 2. UPSERTs to PostgreSQL (permanent storage) 3. Progress now survives Redis expiry **When to call:** - User leaves chapter (navigate away) - User closes tab (beforeunload event) - User opens different chapter - Optional: Periodic background sync (every 60 seconds) **Performance:** - Single DB write per chapter session - Prevents PostgreSQL spam from rapid page turns **Multi-device sync:** - PostgreSQL data accessible from any device - Resume reading from where you left off requestBody: required: true content: application/json: schema: type: object required: - chapterId properties: chapterId: type: string format: uuid description: Chapter ID to sync example: chapterId: 73af4d8d-1532-4a72-b1b9-8f4e5cd295c9 responses: '200': description: Progress synced to PostgreSQL content: application/json: example: result: ok message: Reading progress synced successfully '401': description: Not authenticated content: application/json: example: error: Unauthorized message: authentication required - please login get: summary: Get all progress for current user description: | Requires authentication. Returns all reading progress for the authenticated user. **Data source:** PostgreSQL (persistent storage) **Note:** This returns permanent progress data, not Redis cache. responses: '200': description: All progress from PostgreSQL content: application/json: example: result: ok data: userId: 123 mangas: "a77742b1-befd-49a4-bff5-1ad4e6b0ef7b": mangaId: a77742b1-befd-49a4-bff5-1ad4e6b0ef7b chapters: "73af4d8d-1532-4a72-b1b9-8f4e5cd295c9": currentPage: 15 totalPages: 53 lastReadAt: '2026-05-10T15:30:00Z' updatedAt: '2026-05-10T15:30:00Z' updatedAt: '2026-05-10T15:30:00Z' '401': description: Not authenticated content: application/json: example: error: Unauthorized message: no session identifier found - please login delete: summary: Delete all progress for current user description: | Requires authentication. Deletes ALL reading progress for the authenticated user. **Deletion scope:** - Removes ALL chapters from Redis cache - Removes ALL chapters from PostgreSQL database - Progress cannot be recovered **Warning:** This action is irreversible! responses: '200': description: All progress deleted from both Redis and PostgreSQL content: application/json: example: result: ok message: All reading progress deleted successfully /reading-progress/chapter/{chapterId}: get: summary: Get one chapter progress description: | Requires authentication. Returns progress for the specified chapter. **Data flow:** 1. Check Redis first (hot cache) 2. If not found, check PostgreSQL 3. If found in PostgreSQL, warm Redis cache 4. Return result **Use case:** Call when opening a chapter to resume from saved page. parameters: - name: chapterId in: path required: true schema: type: string format: uuid - name: mangaId in: query required: true schema: type: string format: uuid responses: '200': description: Progress found (from Redis or PostgreSQL) content: application/json: example: result: ok data: userId: 123 mangaId: a77742b1-befd-49a4-bff5-1ad4e6b0ef7b chapterId: 73af4d8d-1532-4a72-b1b9-8f4e5cd295c9 currentPage: 15 totalPages: 53 lastReadAt: '2026-05-10T15:30:00Z' '404': description: No saved progress (user hasn't read this chapter) content: application/json: example: result: not_found message: No progress found for this chapter '401': description: Not authenticated content: application/json: example: error: Unauthorized message: authentication required - please login delete: summary: Delete one chapter progress description: | Requires authentication. Deletes progress for the specified chapter. **Deletion scope:** - Removes from Redis cache - Removes from PostgreSQL database - Progress cannot be recovered parameters: - name: chapterId in: path required: true schema: type: string format: uuid responses: '200': description: Deleted from both Redis and PostgreSQL content: application/json: example: result: ok message: Reading progress deleted successfully /reading-progress/manga/{mangaId}: get: summary: Get all chapter progress for one manga description: | Requires authentication. Returns all chapter progress for the specified manga. **Data source:** PostgreSQL (persistent storage) **Use case:** Display all chapters read for a manga, reading history. parameters: - name: mangaId in: path required: true schema: type: string format: uuid responses: '200': description: All chapters progress for this manga content: application/json: example: result: ok data: mangaId: a77742b1-befd-49a4-bff5-1ad4e6b0ef7b chapters: "73af4d8d-1532-4a72-b1b9-8f4e5cd295c9": currentPage: 15 totalPages: 53 lastReadAt: '2026-05-10T15:30:00Z' "a427cb06-e804-4eea-8723-3392f2922e8f": currentPage: 1 totalPages: 45 lastReadAt: '2026-05-09T14:20:00Z' updatedAt: '2026-05-10T15:30:00Z' delete: summary: Delete all progress for one manga description: | Requires authentication. Deletes all chapter progress for the specified manga. **Deletion scope:** - Removes all chapters from Redis cache - Removes all chapters from PostgreSQL database - Progress cannot be recovered parameters: - name: mangaId in: path required: true schema: type: string format: uuid responses: '200': description: All manga chapters deleted from both Redis and PostgreSQL content: application/json: example: result: ok message: Manga progress deleted successfully /reading-progress/manga-list: get: summary: Get list of read manga IDs description: | Requires authentication. Returns list of manga IDs that the user has read. **Data source:** PostgreSQL (DISTINCT manga_id query) **Use case:** Display "Continue Reading" list, reading library. responses: '200': description: List of manga IDs with reading progress content: application/json: example: result: ok data: - a77742b1-befd-49a4-bff5-1ad4e6b0ef7b - b88853c2-cfge-50b5-cgg6-2be5f7c1fg8c - c99964d3-dhgh-61c6-dhh7-3cf6g8d2gh9d count: 3 /images/{path}: get: summary: Serve downloaded image files security: [] parameters: - name: path in: path required: true schema: type: string example: manga/{mangaId}/chapters/{chapterId}/1.jpg responses: '200': description: Image binary stream
